subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in WI-27. (C)WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is crossed with MT-INFO (music information). The diagram is structurally distinctive: it has *two disjoint sub-diagrams* connected only via the conceptual crossing. WO-EXP-PRI is fed by ALT-F (alternative functionalism), ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics), and STF (source transfer) — three independent feeds. The crossing partner side runs MT-INFO → C-CONT (composite continuance), with COS-D (cosmic dictates) also → C-CONT. A separate sub-diagram: SI (source initiation) → SOC-RT (social reality), INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) → SOC-RT, INFO-DE-B → SI, and COS-D → SI (the only cross-connection between the two halves, via cosmic dictates). Structural argument: world-expansion-principle and music-information are crossed but their downstreams are *parallel and largely independent* — the WO-EXP-PRI side requires alternative functionalism, accelerated dynamics, and source transfer; the MT-INFO side requires composite continuance fed by cosmic dictates. The third sub-structure (SI fed by COS-D and INFO-DE-B, producing SOC-RT with individual-dynamics) shows source-initiation operating in parallel without direct connection to either crossing partner. The diagram thus diagrams the WI section's structural diagnosis: the world-expansion-principle and music-information can be nominally crossed without their downstreams actually meeting, with cosmic-dictates as the only structural bridge. This is the white improvisor's institutional position — nominal participation in the crossing, but downstream chains running in parallel rather than convergent.
